protocol.ndcg_relevance: binary; one relevant path per query
protocol.latency_clock: perf_counter_ns around the complete LocalRagWorkerClient method call

percentile_method: linear interpolation on sorted samples at position (n - 1) * p
interpretation_limits: This is a small synthetic regression fixture, not a representative user-project benchmark.
Search timing includes process startup, local artifact hash verification, ONNX session construction, retrieval and response parsing because each fixed worker accepts one request.
The worker does not expose internal embedding, lexical, dense or fusion timings; these are not inferred or claimed.
No threshold may be lowered after seeing measured results; failed or inconclusive targets remain explicitly reported.
